stories.title: Provisioning steps run exactly once, even when two workers advance the same job
stories.story: As a Nabd platform operator I want each provisioning step to run exactly once and the job list to load in one query so that a new clinic is never half-created or double-seeded.
stories.context: ProvisioningService.advance() reads the next queued step and runs it with no transaction or lock, so two concurrent calls (operator double-click, retry, or two worker pods) can run seed_masters or provision_whatsapp twice (MF-72, ARCH-26). listJobs() loads steps per job (N+1). Fix with a compare-and-set on master.provisioning_job_steps.status (queued -> running only if still queued) inside one transaction per step, and a single joined query for the job list. This unblocks the self-serve trial (ADM-003), which advances jobs automatically rather than by operator clicks. Rollback (V9) must keep working: a failed step still rolls back the earlier done steps in reverse order.
acceptance: Given two threads call advance() on the same job at the same moment, when both try to start step seed_masters, then exactly one runs it and the other returns the job unchanged (no second seed rows)
Given a job with 6 steps, when an operator lists 50 jobs, then the service issues one SQL query for jobs plus steps (asserted by a query-count test)
Given step provision_whatsapp fails, when the job rolls back, then done steps are undone in reverse order and the job ends rolled_back, as today
Given a step is stuck in running for more than 10 minutes, when the reaper job runs, then the step is marked failed with error_detail 'timeout' and the job can be retried

stories.story: As an owner I want to set each person's weekly shifts, including split shifts like 09-14 and 17-21 counted as one working day, and switch to a Ramadan roster, so that everyone knows when they work and changes reach them on WhatsApp.
stories.context: CAD-09 (built in part): staff_shifts with pattern_json exists (V17) with list/add only. Move shifts into a new hr module, add a weekly roster grid, edit and delete, effective-date versions, a Ramadan template (switched by ADM-031), and WhatsApp notices of changes to the staff member (utility template, no patient data). Doctor clinic sessions remain ACC's schedule; this is staff working time. The plan entitlement 'hr' gates the screen.
acceptance: Given a receptionist with shifts Mon-Sat 09-14 and 17-21, when saved, then the roster grid shows a split-shift cell and payroll counts each day as one working day
Given the owner changes Thursday's shift, when saved, then the receptionist gets a WhatsApp notice within 1 minute
Given the Ramadan season switch fires, when the roster renders, then staff with a Ramadan template show Ramadan hours from that date
Given a shift change effective next Monday, when viewing this week, then the old pattern still applies

stories.title: Staff check in from their phone inside the clinic geofence or with a desk PIN
stories.story: As a staff member I want to check in and out from my phone when I'm at the clinic, or with a 4-digit PIN on the reception PC if I have no smartphone, so that attendance is recorded without a biometric machine.
stories.context: CAD-09 optional check-in/out; prototype attendance tab. attendance_records (V17) exists. Phone check-in uses the staff PWA with browser geolocation inside a configurable geofence (default 150 m) and works on 3G; desk PIN check-in uses the shared reception PC (passwordless PIN per staff, existing pin_hash). A biometric connector is out of scope (optional later). Owner sees today's status (on time, late with minutes, on leave, absent not informed) and can correct records with a reason; corrections are locked after the month is locked (ADM-057).
acceptance: Given a nurse inside the geofence, when she taps check in, then a record with time and method 'phone' is saved within 2 s
Given a phone outside the geofence, when check in is tapped, then it is refused with the distance shown and no record is written
Given a receptionist without a smartphone, when she enters her PIN on the reception PC, then she is checked in with method 'desk_pin'
Given a staff member checks in 14 minutes after shift start, when the owner views today, then they show 'Late 14 min'
Given location, when stored, then only inside/outside and distance are kept, not raw coordinates

stories.title: Staff request leave and the owner approves it, with patient impact shown for doctors
stories.story: As an owner I want leave requests with type and dates, approve or decline in one tap, and for a doctor's leave see how many booked patients are affected and have them offered another doctor or date automatically, so that leave never surprises patients.
stories.context: Prototype leave tab and B-65. Leave types and yearly balances per staff; approval writes leave into hr and, for clinicians, publishes an event that ACC uses to block the doctor's sessions (scheduling owns doctor leave and patient rebooking, T-161/T-302). Balance is decremented on approval; declines carry a note to the requester.

stories.title: Owner exports a monthly payroll file for the accountant in the local format and locks the month
stories.story: As an owner I want one click to produce the month's payroll file (days, hours, overtime, leave, salary, advances and deductions) as CSV, Tally XML or Zoho Payroll in India, a WPS SIF file in the UAE or Qatar, or a Mudad WPS file in KSA, and then lock the month, so that my accountant runs payroll without retyping.
stories.context: CAD-10 (simple payroll export, no payroll engine) exists as GET /v1/setup/payroll-export returning rows. Add salary and advance/deduction fields per staff (encrypted), format writers per market, a month lock after which attendance corrections need owner approval, and delivery to the accountant by email secure link. PF/ESI/TDS (India) and GOSI (KSA) are calculated by the accountant; the file carries the fields they need. Payroll engines stay out of scope (DEC-15 note in T-381).
acceptance: Given September attendance, when the owner exports CSV, then each staff row has days worked, hours, overtime hours, leave days, salary and advance/deduction matching the attendance and leave records
Given an India tenant, when Tally XML is chosen, then the file imports into Tally Prime as payroll vouchers in a test company without errors
Given a UAE tenant, when WPS SIF is chosen, then the file passes the SIF format validator (EDR/SCR records, employer and bank routing codes)
Given the owner locks September, when anyone edits a September attendance record, then 423 MONTH_LOCKED unless the owner approves an unlock with a reason
Given salary fields, when stored, then they are encrypted and visible only with hr:manage

stories.title: Ward manager publishes a weekly duty roster with skill mix, swaps and rule checks
stories.story: As a hospital nursing/ward manager I want a weekly roster per ward and department with M/E/N shifts, minimum skill mix per shift, swap requests and leave, with rule checks (rest >= 11 h, max 12 h continuous, weekly hours <= 48), published to staff phones, so that every shift is covered safely.

Prototype hospops.roster shows coverage gaps, swap requests, overtime and rule breaches, and an 'auto-fill gaps' suggestion from the float pool. Builds on the hr module (ADM-054..057); attendance feeds the existing payroll export.

Given a swap that would give a nurse less than 11 h rest, when requested, then it is refused with the rule named
Given the manager publishes next week, when published, then all rostered staff get a WhatsApp notice and the roster is read-only except via swaps
Given approved leave, when the roster is built, then the person is excluded and a gap is shown with float-pool suggestions within weekly hour limits

open_questions: T-356 (post-visit feedback, NPS and complaints queue) belongs to COM (recall, reviews and feedback). ADM-041 shows an NPS tile only when COM's feedback data exists; please confirm COM owns it.

T-357 has three parts. ADM covers delegations (ADM-019) and the tenant lifecycle console (ADM-020). The part where the desk sees guardian age-18 reviews that are due belongs to IDC and is covered by IDC-012.
T-334 has three parts. ADM covers the traffic-light compliance health card (ADM-033). The per-facility versioned privacy notice and the grievance contact belong to IDC and are covered by IDC-025.

T-332 (multi-branch lite, area Tenancy), T-305 (preset role bundles, area Auth) and T-271 (Hijri, prayer times and Ramadan, area i18n/RTL) are filed under other areas, but the ADM brief puts them in ADM's scope. ADM has specced them (ADM-022..027, ADM-017, ADM-029..031). The Platform/Trust and i18n PSEs should not duplicate them; please confirm.

Cross-branch double-booking of a doctor who works at two branches (prototype: 'schedules are checked against each other') is a scheduling rule and belongs to ACC (it relates to T-247, the unified doctor calendar). ADM-022 only copies the schedule.
T-381 (ward duty roster) depends on DEC-15 (build or partner for hospital modules), which is deferred to month 12. ADM-058 is specced but stays behind the ipd entitlement.

DEC-10 and DEC-34 (pricing model: free Solo Starter; per-clinic vs per-doctor) are still open. ADM-034 (pricing_basis) and ADM-004 (on_trial_expiry) are designed so that either answer works. Commercial still needs to confirm trial length (14 days assumed) and the free-plan visit cap.
DEC-35 (WhatsApp pricing: markup vs fair-use allowance) changes how usage is shown on the plan page (ADM-037). Usage data depends on T-365 (per-tenant cost attribution).

DPA signing method: is an OTP click-through enough in each market, or must India use Aadhaar eSign and KSA Nafath? ADM-002 treats OTP as the baseline and the others as optional. Counsel needs to confirm.

Offboarding (ADM-016) gives the clinic every record in the export and keeps nothing, including the 8-year GST invoices. Counsel needs to confirm that a processor may delete these once the controller holds them.
Migration numbers V300-V336 and cp/V1-V14 are placeholders reserved for ADM. Data & Infra needs to confirm a numbering scheme across domains so numbers do not collide.
Rollups (T-112) and the OLAP pipeline belong to the Data domain. ADM-041 adds time-KPI columns, and ADM-045 assumes the Data domain picks the OLAP store (ClickHouse or a Postgres analytics replica).
Tax registrations, invoice series and per-branch fee overrides are FIN's (T-107, T-306). ADM-024 only owns the branch settings orchestration and UI.
The import story ADM-013 writes drug and stock lists through the Pharmacy domain's StockCommands. The Pharmacy PSE should confirm that API exists by Phase 1.
DEC-29 ('corporates') is open. If it means employer billing, a corporate-accounts epic is needed. ADM has not specced it.
